summary: document <id> exits non-zero with a not-found error when no Master record exists for the ID.
reason: A recorded document IS its Master record, so an unresolvable document ID is a not-found condition (like HTTP 404) and must fail, unlike bbl/debt where an empty result set for a valid tax lot is a legitimate zero-row answer. Preserves agent-friendly failure signaling and the point-lookup error contract.
